subject: Request: Bridge letter and evidence sync for Solstice Health (post-period coverage)
messages:
From: Elena Marin <elena.m@solsticehealth.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: compliance@solsticehealth.com
Date: 2026-11-28T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Request: Bridge letter and evidence sync for Solstice Health (post-period coverage)

Hi David,

Thanks again for the SOC 2 report you provided — our audit committee reviewed it today. We have a follow-up ask from our compliance team: given the report period ended 2026-09-30, can Redwood provide a bridge letter (or interim attestation) that covers the period from 2026-10-01 to the date of issuance to address a regulatory filing window?

Specifically, could you confirm:
- Whether Redwood can attest that there were no SOC-scope control exceptions or material security incidents in the interim period (2026-10-01 -> current), or alternatively provide an exception disclosure if applicable.
- If you can provide a short bridge letter signed by an authorized executive plus an evidence index listing supporting artifacts (change control records, KMS rotation notes, sampled access logs, recent SOC-related incident tickets).
- A reasonable target date for delivery and whether you require a non-disclosure addendum for us to accept any sensitive log samples.

We are hoping to receive the bridge letter and an initial evidence index within 10 business days. If helpful, I can share our internal evidence checklist (we prefer CSV/Excel indexes and short log snippets rather than full archives).

Appreciate a quick confirmation of next steps and who on your team will coordinate.

Thanks,
Elena Marin
Head of Compliance
Solstice Health

--
Attachment: solstice-evidence-checklist-template.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)

From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
To: Elena Marin <elena.m@solsticehealth.com>
Cc: Oliver Price <oliver.price@solsticehealth.com>
Date: 2026-11-28T10:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: Bridge letter and evidence sync for Solstice Health (post-period coverage)

Hi Elena — thanks for the clear note and the checklist. We can support a bridge letter covering 2026-10-01 through the issuance date. A few clarifying items so we scope correctly:

1) For "no control exceptions," do you need a binary statement (no exceptions identified) or a narrative that calls out the scope we reviewed? Either works but the wording affects signatory cadence.
2) For logs: are short redacted snippets sufficient (e.g., last 7 days of admin event types) or do you need longer historical exports?
3) If you want DocuSign routing to an exec at Redwood, we will need legal clearance; please confirm the final signatory name.

I'll loop in our SOC ops and evidence owners and propose an internal timeline. We should be able to produce a draft bridge letter + evidence index and a small set of sample logs within 5 business days if we stick to redacted snippets.

Proposed next step: I will forward this to our SOC-ops lead and legal; can we schedule a 30-min sync tomorrow if that helps?

Best,
David Kim
Director, GRC & Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

--
Attachment: redwood-initial-ack.xlsx (internal stub)

From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-28T12:30:00-08:00
Subject: Fwd: Request: Bridge letter and evidence sync for Solstice Health (post-period coverage)

Team — forwarding Solstice's request. TL;DR: they want a bridge note covering 2026-10-01 -> issuance date, plus an evidence index and a few sample logs. They prefer CSV/Excel index.

Action items:
- Priyom: assemble evidence index spreadsheet (columns: artifact, owner, date range, redaction level, access link). Target: initial draft by 2026-11-30 EOD. Include change control records (Oct–Nov), KMS rotation notes, and at least one example access log snippet.
- Naomi: pull a 7-day admin event snippet (redacted PII) from 2026-11-20 -> 2026-11-27 and provide guidance on redaction. Put the log in the secure Drive folder and mark as sample-only.
- Marissa: draft a one-page bridge letter with two options: (A) binary statement ("no SOC-scope control exceptions observed"), (B) narrative with scope + exceptions if any. We expect legal to prefer the narrative. Draft due: 2026-11-30 AM so we can route for legal review.

Keep responses short here — if any blockers, flag immediately. I'll own external comms and routing to legal for signature.

Thanks,
David

--
Internal note: Marissa — please include a signatory placeholder for VP, Legal and a DocuSign workflow when ready.
